read.title: A Gift from Lumi Seoul
read.text:
Hi Chloe,

I'm Minsu from Lumi Seoul, a Korean skincare brand. We've been following your skincare routines for a while, and we'd love to send you a PR package with our new Rice Glow Essence.

There's no obligation to post, but if you enjoy it, we'd be thrilled to see an unboxing story or an honest review. We're seeding the product to 30 creators ahead of our U.S. launch in January.

Just reply with your shipping address, and we'll send it out this week.

Best,
Minsu
